intro.text: A young lord of little importance at the Arelene court, whom Hrathen urges to convert to Shu-Dereth.

items.text: Hrathen and Dilaf urged several unimportant young lords to convert, Idan among them, alongside Ramear and Idan's cousin Waren; Hrathen hoped greater lords would follow once the government wavered. Idan at first could not see what he would gain, but was soon won over, and Hrathen put little value on a convert so easily swayed.
